thag3.7:1.1: Yo 'dha koci manussesu parapāṇāni hiṃsati, asmā lokā paramhā ca ubhayā dhaṃsate naro. || ||
thag3.7:2.1: yo ca mettena cittena sabbapāṇ' ānukampati, bahuṃ hi so pasavati puññaṃ tādisako naro. || ||
thag3.7:3.1: subhāsitassa sikkhetha samaṇupāsanassa ca ekāsanassa ca raho cittavūpasamassa cā 'ti. || || Vāraṇathero.
